summary_en: 297,545 treasury shares (3.0% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) to be cancelled effective 31 July 2026 at reference time immediately before Gakken Holdings acquisition of all issued shares via stock exchange.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: RareJob announced on 23 July 2026 that its board has resolved to cancel all treasury shares held at the reference time (immediately before Gakken Holdings acquires all issued shares via stock exchange on 31 July 2026). As of 31 March 2026, the company held 297,545 treasury shares out of 9,845,600 shares outstanding (excluding treasury), representing 3.0% of shares outstanding ex-treasury. The cancellation is mandated by the stock exchange agreement between RareJob and Gakken Holdings signed on 15 May 2026, under which Gakken will acquire 100% of RareJob's issued shares (excluding those already held by Gakken) on 31 July 2026. The cancellation will take effect on that same date at the reference time, and includes any treasury shares RareJob acquires through statutory appraisal rights (反対株主の株式買取請求) under Companies Act §785 during the exchange process.
